binary_observations: 0x20D944 copies parser RCX to R13, preserving the parsed-model destination.
0x20DC50 computes RCX = R13 + 0x88 and calls 0x22A8A0 to construct the selector material container in that model.
selector caller 0x20DDD1 preserves its incoming RCX in RDI.
0x20E011 passes RSI as selector RCX and 0x20E014 calls selector 0x22BA20.
Thus parser and selector use the same model-relative container contract: model + 0x88.
guardrails: pointer is only a lifetime join key, never asset identity
asset identity is canonical SHA-256 of untouched raw FLVER
stale pointer reuse must be prevented by certified invalidation
remaining_open_edge: Exact model destruction/unload invalidation point remains to be certified.
